payload.body_they: {{Name}} may spend part of their life learning the difference between what they genuinely like and what gets the best response from other people. They notice compliments, attraction, and what people say suits them, which can make approval easy to read before their own preference is fully clear. Something can look perfect from the outside and still not feel like their choice. Being wanted does not tell them if they want the relationship.
